description: For policy acknowledgment, this intake form records required reading, training dependency, questions, disclosure or consent boundaries, acknowledgment deadline, and exceptions. Its supporting evidence includes delivery record, training completion, employee questions, accessible-format request, acknowledgment, and manager follow-up.

blocks.guidance: Identify the exact policy copy assigned for distribution.
blocks.label: Policy Assignment Reference

blocks.guidance: Identify the intended recipient and a usable delivery format.
blocks.label: Recipient and Access Needs

sections.guidance: Identify the exact policy version, recipient, language, location, and delivery channel.
sections.title: Policy Intake Assignment and Recipient

blocks.guidance: Set the delivery, training, support, and deadline requirements.
blocks.label: Distribution and Support Setup

blocks.guidance: Use this record only to document delivery, reading, questions, training, and receipt. Route rights, consent, conflict, or policy interpretation questions for qualified review.
blocks.label: Acknowledgment Is Not Consent or Waiver

sections.guidance: Configure required reading, training, support, deadline, and a question owner.
sections.title: Policy Intake Setup and Support

blocks.guidance: Release only a complete, accessible assignment.
blocks.label: Setup Disposition and Record Location

sections.guidance: Approve only a complete, accessible distribution assignment.
sections.title: Intake Disposition and Approval

subtitle: Policy Acknowledgment Intake Form: workplace policy distribution and acknowledgment using policy identifier, required reading, and delivery record.
title: Policy Acknowledgment Intake Form
use_case: Use the intake form during workplace policy distribution and acknowledgment when the policy acknowledgment record must identify policy identifier, version, effective date, audience, employee identity, location, language, and delivery channel. Complete the applicable handoff for acknowledgment timestamp, exception routing, overdue follow-up, version retention, training linkage, and HR record handoff.
